items.name: Hamburger Pizza
items.description: A stonebaked pizza base topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, spicy meatballs, sliced gherkins, red onion and burger sauce, cooked until piping hot with a crisp base and burger-style finish.

items.name: Banana Smores Pizza
items.description: Dessert pizza topped with smooth chocolate spread, sliced banana and chopped marshmallow, baked until crisp, then finished with banana chips and crushed digestive biscuit.

items.name: Tandoori Delight Pizza
items.description: A stonebaked pizza base topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, tandoori chicken, sweetcorn and a mango chutney mayonnaise drizzle, cooked until piping hot with a crisp base and vibrant spiced finish.

items.name: Toffee Apple Crumble Pizza
items.description: Dessert pizza topped with toffee sauce, apple pieces, icing sugar and granola, baked until crisp and served hot.

items.name: Hawaiian Pizza
items.description: A classic 10 inch Hawaiian pizza with rich tomato sauce, melted mozzarella, smoked ham and sweet pineapple, cooked until piping hot with an even golden finish.
